title: Supreme Court orders SIT probe into murder of Madhya Pradesh Congress leader's driver
description: The Supreme Court on Monday directed the constitution of a Special Investigation Team (SIT) to investigate the murder of the driver of a Congress party leader in Madhya Pradesh.
